parts.name: Double T-Slot Bearing Pad Kit
parts.description: Double T-slot bearing pad kit for counterbalance systems, with a low friction UHMW-PE pad that guides within the T-slot. It attaches with the included M4 set screw and T-nut and can be used for a variety of linear motion applications.
features: Double T-slot bearing for counterbalance systems
Low friction UHMW-PE pad to guide within the T-slot
Allows for greater margin of error for installation alignment
Retaining wings to hold pad captive in 8mm and 10mmT-slot
Attaches with included M4 set screw & T-Nut
Can be used for a variety of linear motion applications
parts.notes: Sold as a kit. Included kit parts: Bearing Pad (1), Self-Aligning T-slot Nut 16, M4, Steel (1), M4 x 20mm Cup Point Set Screw (1). Series badges printed: 15, 30, 40, 45 (the 30/40/45 badges are metric series).

parts.name: Counterbalance Cable Kit
parts.description: Counterbalance cable kit with a die cast zinc cable bracket that attaches directly to the T-slot and 20 ft of 1/16” 7 X 19 stainless steel cable with a ball shank end captured by the bracket. Three wire rope clamps are included.
features: Die cast zinc cable bracket (Attaches directly to T-slot with provided M4 BHSCS & T-Nut)
Cable includes ball shank on end to be captured by cable bracket
Three galvanized iron wire rope clamps for 1/16” cable diameter
150 lb (68.04 kg) load capacity when using the provided wire clamps
Lower screw helps retain ball shank in cable bracket
parts.notes: Sold as a kit. Load capacity 150 lb (68.04 kg) when using the provided wire clamps. Included kit parts: Cable Bracket (1), 18-8 Stainless Steel Corrosion-Resistant Wire Rope (1), 1/16” Cable Clamp (3), Self-Aligning T-slot Nut 16, M4, Steel (2), M4 x 12mm BHSCS (2). Series badges printed: 15, 40, 45 (the 40/45 badges are metric series).

parts.name: Snap-In Conduit Profile
parts.description: One-piece PVC conduit with a flexible hinge that snaps into 8mm T-slot profile. It provides a storage compartment for counterbalance weight, cables or air lines.
features: Storage compartment for counterbalance weight, cables or air lines
One piece construction with flexible hinge
parts.notes: Counterbalance Weights 6303 and 6310 install within this conduit. Series badges printed: 15, 40 (the 40 badge is metric series). No section properties are listed, so it is not treated as a structural T-slot profile.

parts.name: Counterbalance Weights
parts.description: Steel counterbalance weight, 9.7” long, that connects to other weights with a slide-in lock feature to reach the desired counterweight. It installs within conduit PN 6354 or internal to T-slot profile while using the internal pulley kit (PN 6351).
features: Easily connect multiple weights to achieve desired counterweight with slide-in lock feature
Installs within conduit PN 6354 or internal to T-slot profile while using internal pulley kit (PN 6351)
parts.notes: Use with Snap-In Conduit Profile 6354 or inside a T-slot profile with internal pulley kit 6351. Series badges printed: F, M (metric hardware).

parts.name: Counterbalance Weights
parts.description: Steel counterbalance weight, 27.7” long, that connects to other weights with a slide-in lock feature to reach the desired counterweight. It installs within conduit PN 6354 or internal to T-slot profile while using the internal pulley kit (PN 6351).
features: Easily connect multiple weights to achieve desired counterweight with slide-in lock feature
Installs within conduit PN 6354 or internal to T-slot profile while using internal pulley kit (PN 6351)
parts.notes: Use with Snap-In Conduit Profile 6354 or inside a T-slot profile with internal pulley kit 6351. Series badges printed: F, M (metric hardware).
